ios.desc:
SSH Terminal In Your Pocket

Anubis brings professional SSH terminal capabilities to your iPhone and iPad. Whether you're a developer using Claude Code remotely, a system administrator, or power user, Anubis provides everything you need to manage servers and execute commands on the go.

  CORE FEATURES
  - Full terminal emulation with SwiftTerm integration
  - Multi-session SSH connections
  - Password and SSH key authentication
  - Real-time command execution with proper ANSI support
  - Dark theme optimized for terminal work
  - Native iOS performance and battery optimization

  CONNECTION MANAGEMENT
  - Save and organize unlimited SSH connections
  - Quick Access favorites for instant connectivity
  - Session persistence across app launches
  - Secure credential storage in iOS Keychain
  - Support for custom ports and connection settings

  SECURITY AND AUTHENTICATION
  - Interactive password authentication
  - SSH private key support (coming soon)
  - Secure credential management
  - End-to-end encrypted connections
  - No data stored on external servers

  PERFECT FOR:
  - Developers coding remotely with Claude Code
  - Managing cloud development environments
  - System administrators on-the-go
  - DevOps professionals
  - Students learning Linux/Unix
  - Anyone needing remote server access

  WHY CHOOSE ANUBIS?
  - Professional-grade terminal emulation
  - Intuitive touch-friendly interface
  - Seamless remote development workflow
  - Regular updates and active development
  - No subscription fees - one-time purchase

  Transform your iPhone into a powerful SSH terminal. Code anywhere, manage servers everywhere. Download Anubis
  and take your development environment in your pocket.

quotes.text:
I built an iOS app for raw dog developers. Anubis is a simple SSH terminal to manage your $5/month Hetzner VPS. Coded it in 5 hours, levelsio style—core PHP, SQLite, vanilla JS, straight on the server. No frameworks, no bloat.

Anubis lets raw doggers SSH into their VPS to code live and deploy fast. One-time purchase, no subscription. Get it here: https://apps.apple.com/be/app/anubis-ssh-terminal/id6751232924 #IndieDev #RawDogDev

Pro tip: Secure your VPS—disable password auth, enable fail2ban, set up UFW. Who's raw dogging their next project?
